scientific_object: In a self-evolving skill library where a skill identity is simultaneously an action handle, an evidence bucket, and a lifecycle unit, exact semantic refinement can change persistent evolution even after selection is removed: identical semantic evidence is partitioned across identity-local sufficient-statistic containers before a nonlinear lifecycle gate. Representation invariance requires the lifecycle decision to commute with semantic evidence aggregation.

formal_residual.interpretation: The left side aggregates evidence at the semantic class before the lifecycle gate; the right side applies the released identity-local lifecycle gate first and then projects identity retirements to the class. A representation defect occurs when they differ.
formal_residual.threshold_corollary: For retirement-eligible evidence, additive attempts, and per-ID threshold M, canonical/quotient retirement occurs at N>=M; balanced k-way exact refinement fully retires at N>=kM; the fragmentation window is M<=N<kM and retirement lag is (k-1)M.
formal_residual.general_partition_corollary: For an arbitrary exact-identity partition, divergence occurs iff aggregate class evidence passes the lifecycle gate while at least one identity-local evidence bucket fails it.
not_claimed_as_novel: quotient dynamics or lumpability in general
identity fragmentation as a generic statistical phenomenon

first_party_realization.paper: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
released_state_mechanism: feedback records are grouped by skill_id
attempts/consistent/too_easy/too_hard/avg_p_hat and related statistics are stored per skill ID
per-ID statistics affect sampling quality/exploration multipliers
prune_easy_skills applies min_attempts and difficulty thresholds per ID
the active skill library is persistent state used by later self-play iterations
first_party_realization.natural_prevalence_limitation: Available release mirrors expose the released loop and initial per-skill stats, but no complete preserved evolved Skill-SP skills.json/retired ledger was found that would establish how frequently endogenous training trajectories enter the fragmentation window.

deterministic_evidence.p0_headline: Eight identical semantic feedback records retire one canonical focal ID; the same eight values split 4/4 across two exact IDs leave the semantic class active; semantic quotient-credit restores the canonical retirement decision. No selection/retrieval is executed before feedback.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Replicating equivalent arms can increase an agent's payoff by exploiting the bandit algorithm's exploration/exploitation balance; replication-proof algorithms remove that selection advantage.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Skill clones simply receive more sampling opportunities.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Freeze and externally provide the identical semantic feedback multiset to every representation; execute no selection or retrieval before evidence assignment.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: P0 still changes the persistent lifecycle decision because evidence is partitioned across per-ID buckets before pruning. The strategic selection advantage is mechanically absent.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Do not claim clone-sensitive sampling as R2 novelty; treat selection duplication as an inherited/known channel.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Multiple actions can induce the same transition distribution, so action entropy/selection can overweight redundant actions relative to state-transition diversity.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Exact skill IDs are just redundant actions.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Remove the action-selection stage entirely and intervene after the semantic feedback values are fixed.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The observed divergence is a persistent evidence/lifecycle update after fixed feedback, not a difference in selected action or next-state transition.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Do not present exact-skill redundancy itself as new.

reduction_matrix.neighbor: MDP homomorphism, state abstraction, bisimulation, and lumpability
reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Mature abstraction theory asks when aggregated states/actions preserve model dynamics or decision-relevant properties; general quotient/lumpability formalisms characterize when dynamics descend to an abstract state space.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: The proposed Quotiented Evolution Operator is merely a relabeling of a standard homomorphism/lumpability condition.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Separate the abstract quotient criterion from the concrete released update mechanism and require a stage-specific ex-ante phase law plus a first-party counterfactual.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The general commuting/quotient equation is fully absorbed and is not claimed as novelty. The surviving contribution is the discovered identity-indexed evidence bucket plus nonlinear lifecycle gate in released self-evolution, its exact fragmentation window, and the semantic-credit intervention.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Never sell quotient existence/commutation alone as a theorem-level novelty.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Equivalent or reparameterized models can follow different gradient trajectories and implicit biases; commuting parametrizations connect gradient flow to mirror descent.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: The future-state difference is just generic reparameterization-dependent learning dynamics.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Use a deterministic released controller replay with no gradient, optimizer, learned parameter, or stochastic training trajectory.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: P0/P1 divergence is generated by sufficient-statistic partition plus a discrete per-ID lifecycle threshold, with a closed-form multiplicity/evidence phase boundary.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Do not use generic 'reparameterization changes learning' as the paper's insight.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: When one real entity is observed under multiple identifiers, fragmented records can bias inference and the bias can have nontrivial direction and magnitude.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Credit fragmentation is merely identity fragmentation in another application domain.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Require a self-evolving artifact whose identity is simultaneously an action handle, persistent evidence bucket, and lifecycle unit, then show a released nonlinear lifecycle decision changes under exact semantic refinement and affects the next active control library.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The abstract fact that identifiers fragment observations is absorbed. The narrower residual is a closed-loop skill-lifecycle mechanism: partition-before-gate changes persistent action availability, with an exact homomorphism criterion, multiplicity-dependent retirement lag, and quotient-credit repair.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Never claim generic identity fragmentation/evidence dilution as novel; position the contribution as a representation-invariance failure of persistent skill lifecycle control.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Under fixed skill content/support, changing retrieval/presentation order did not yield a novel residual beyond mature history-conditioned/path-dependence baselines in the closed P15 object.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: The R2 effect is just another generic history/path-dependence effect.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Hold feedback sequence/content fixed and remove retrieval/order as an intervention axis; change only exact identity partition of the evidence containers immediately before a released update gate.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The ex-ante phase law is stage-local and representation-specific; quotient-credit, not a generic history model, directly restores the canonical lifecycle decision.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Avoid generic hysteresis/path-dependence language and preserve the P15 closure.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: An earlier reconvergence/hysteresis idea lacked qualified controlled units and was killed rather than upgraded into a mechanism claim.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: R2 merely resurrects a previously killed 'same final state, different path' story.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Use a released deterministic update function with an exact identity intervention, a frozen exogenous evidence multiset, and an explicit semantic aggregation control; no world-state reconvergence is required.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The mechanism is identified at one lifecycle gate before generic trajectory/hysteresis claims arise.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Do not reopen or cite the old hysteresis object as supporting evidence.

reduction_matrix.neighbor: SkillOS: learned skill curation for self-evolving agents
reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: A trainable curator updates a persistent SkillRepo from accumulated experience and learns reuse/refine/create decisions under delayed feedback.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Persistent skill curation and credit are already a studied self-evolution object.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Ask whether exact semantic identity refinement alone, under identical feedback and fixed curator information, is audited for invariance of persistent lifecycle decisions.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The published abstract establishes learned curation from accumulated experience, but does not itself identify the exact-identity evidence-partition counterfactual or the aggregation-before-gate invariance criterion.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: Related work must acknowledge persistent curation; novelty cannot be 'skills receive feedback and evolve'.

reduction_matrix.neighbor: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agent Skills: Feedback Dynamics over Multiple Rounds
reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: Controlled multi-round skill evolution varies the feedback shown to the optimizer (success/failure views), studies validation-gated sparse updates, and evaluates persistent skill evolution across benchmarks/models.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Feedback composition and validation-gated lifecycle dynamics are already analyzed directly.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Hold the semantic feedback multiset exactly fixed and vary only the partition of that same evidence across exact-semantic skill identities before a released lifecycle gate.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The closest current self-evolution neighbor changes which feedback content/views are available; R2's identifying intervention preserves feedback content and isolates identity partition as the sole changed variable.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: R2 must be framed as representation invariance of credit/lifecycle under fixed feedback, not as a general study of feedback dynamics.

reduction_matrix.what_it_explains: SkillsVote attributes execution outcomes to skill use, exploration, environment, and result signals and admits reusable discoveries to evidence-gated updates.
reduction_matrix.strongest_reduction_attack: Skill-linked attribution and evidence-gated skill updates are already explicit lifecycle-governance mechanisms.
reduction_matrix.same_information_test: Require an exact-semantic identity split with identical attributed evidence and test whether the evidence gate commutes with class-level aggregation.
reduction_matrix.r2_residual: The published abstract establishes skill-linked outcome attribution and evidence-gated updates but not the exact identity-refinement invariance audit or threshold fragmentation phase law.
reduction_matrix.novelty_implication: R2 must not claim novelty for skill-linked credit assignment or gated updates themselves.

reduction_summary.surviving_residual: Exact semantic identity refinement partitions identical post-selection evidence across persistent skill-local state containers before a nonlinear lifecycle gate, thereby changing the future active skill library; semantic/class-level credit aggregation restores the canonical lifecycle decision.
reduction_summary.why_same_information: P0/P1 execute no selection/retrieval before feedback, use the identical semantic feedback values, exact focal content/support, the same released functions/defaults, and differ only in identity partition or semantic aggregation of evidence.
reduction_summary.why_mechanistic: The effect is localized to a named released state variable and update gate, has an exact counterfactual intervention, yields a closed-form phase boundary, and changes the persistent control state used by later self-play rounds.
reduction_summary.why_not_yet_main_story: Natural prevalence under endogenous Skill-SP trajectories is unresolved; the mechanism has one released system realization; no downstream task-utility consequence or cross-system generality has been established; R19's task-general AutoSkill behavior STOP remains binding.

gate.allowed_next_step: Freeze and execute a deterministic 2x2 decomposition of selection handling (native vs semantic quotient) and credit/lifecycle handling (native per-ID vs semantic quotient) using the released Skill-SP controller, to separate the inherited selection-duplication channel from the newly identified post-selection credit-fragmentation channel.
not_authorized: R2 title/manuscript replacement before the decomposition and prevalence gates
reviving generic QEO, path-dependence, or hysteresis novelty
gate.stop_if: If a stronger closest work is found that studies exact-semantic identity refinement under identical post-selection feedback and proves/repairs the same persistent lifecycle noncommutativity, or if the 2x2 decomposition cannot isolate a credit-side effect after semantic selection is quotient-corrected, retain canonical R19 and stop R2 redesign.
